findings.summary: Changing the type assertion in AssertExpectationsForObjects from Mock to *Mock means a Mock value no longer matches and falls through to the assertExpectationser assertion, which panics because AssertExpectations has a pointer receiver.

judge.reason: Describes the same panic when a Mock value falls through to the unchecked assertExpectationser assertion.

votes.label: hit
votes.reason: Describes the same panic when a Mock value falls through to the unchecked assertExpectationser assertion.

votes.label: hit
votes.reason: Describes the same panic when a Mock value falls through to the unchecked assertion due to the *Mock change.

votes.label: hit
votes.reason: Describes the same panic when a Mock value falls through to the unchecked assertion because of the pointer receiver.

votes.label: hit
votes.reason: Same cause and effect: the *Mock assertion misses a Mock value, which then falls through to the unchecked interface assertion and panics.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: A *Mock (e.g. &myMock.Mock), the correct call style, now hits the branch that logs the 'Deprecated…' warning, so the warning is wrong for pointers.

judge.reason: Related to the known deprecation message issue; a *Mock hitting the deprecation branch makes the warning misleading, but it is not the panic bug.

votes.label: valid_other
votes.reason: Related to the known deprecation message issue; a *Mock hitting the deprecation branch makes the warning misleading, but it is not the panic bug.

votes.label: false_alarm
votes.reason: Claims pointer hits the deprecated branch; the *Mock branch is the intended check, and the real issue is the by-value case, so this is not the keyed bug and is likely wrong.

votes.label: valid_other
votes.reason: Matches the known problem that the deprecation message is wrong or unreachable for the by-value form it describes, so it is a real defect but not b1.

votes.label: false_alarm
votes.reason: Passing &myMock.Mock is not the recommended call style (that is passing myMock), so logging the deprecation for it is not a real defect, and the finding does not describe the panic.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: Making the mutex a non-pointer sync.Mutex means any code or test that copies a Mock by value (including a restored value case) triggers go vet copylocks warnings.

judge.reason: Matches the known copylocks problem from the by-value sync.Mutex.

votes.label: valid_other

votes.label: valid_other
votes.reason: Matches the known copylocks problem from holding sync.Mutex by value.

votes.label: valid_other
votes.reason: Matches the known issue: Mock holding a sync.Mutex by value means copying it triggers go vet copylocks warnings.
